player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id}. You are playing the Memory Game.
Your goal is to match more pairs of cards on the board, than your opponent.
On your turn, select two cards to flip by entering the row and column numbers of the first and second card respectively like '[0 1 1 0]', where the first card is in row 0 and column 1, and the second card is in row 1 and column 0.
If the two cards match, you get a point and the cards remain face up. If they do not match, the cards are flipped back face down, e.g. '.'.
The game ends when all pairs have been matched.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mofuta oa motsamao o sa sebetseng. Sebapali {player_id} ha sea ka sa arabela ka tsela e nepahetseng ea ho tsamaea pakeng tsa li-brackets tse sekwere.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Mohato o sa sebetseng. Sebapali {player_id} se khethile boemo bo ka ntle ho meeli ea papali.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Ho falla ho sa nepahalang. Sebapali {player_id} se khethile karete e tšoanang habeli.
invalid_move.already_matched: Ho falla ho sa sebetseng. Sebapali {player_id} se khethile karete e le 'ngoe kapa ka bobeli tse seng li ntse li bapisoa.

game_message.cards_match: The cards selected by Player {player_id} at positions [{r1} {c1}] and [{r2} {c2}] match!
game_message.cards_no_match: The cards selected by Player {player_id} do not match. Cards at positions [{r1} {c1}] and [{r2} {c2}] are {pos1} and {pos2} respectively.

outcome.draw: Libapali ka bobeli li ne li bapisa palo e lekanang ea likarete.
outcome.turn_limit: Mofuta wa turn o fihlile. Pino e fihlile. Player 0 o ile a fumana {score_0} dipontsho, Player 1 o ile a fumana {score_1} dipontsho.
